intro.a_free_and_open_source_client_for_jellyf: A free and open-source client for Jellyfin.
intro.features_description: Streamyfin includes several features and integrations. You'll find them in Settings:
intro.seerr_feature_description: Connect your Seerr instance to request movies and series right from the app.
intro.downloads_feature_description: Download movies and series to watch offline.
intro.chromecast_feature_description: Cast movies and series to your Chromecast devices.
intro.centralised_settings_plugin_description: Manage settings centrally on your Jellyfin server. Client settings sync automatically for every user.
intro.crash_reports_description: Streamyfin sends anonymous crash and error reports to the developers. No account data or server addresses are included. You can turn this off here or anytime in Settings.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.download_live_activity_hint: Show download progress on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.
appearance.merge_next_up_continue_watching: Merge Continue watching and Next up
appearance.merge_next_up_continue_watching_hint: Show both in a single row on the home screen.
appearance.show_upcoming_on_home_hint: Add a home screen row with episodes airing soon in your TV libraries.
appearance.use_episode_images_next_up_hint: Show episode thumbnails instead of series artwork in Continue watching and Next up.
appearance.hide_remote_session_button_hint: Hide the remote session button in the home screen header.
appearance.show_hero_carousel_hint: Show the large swipeable carousel at the top of the home screen.

network.title: Network
network.auto_switch_description: Use the local URL when connected to your home Wi-Fi.
network.local_url_hint: Your server's local address, e.g. http://192.168.1.100:8096
network.local_url_not_saved: Not saved. No Jellyfin server responded. Start the address with http:// or https:// to save it anyway.
network.local_url_unusable: This address isn't in use. Enter it again, starting with http:// or https://.
network.local_url_saved_unanswered: Saved, but no Jellyfin server responded at this address.
network.add_network_hint: Add your home Wi-Fi network to enable auto-switching.
network.permission_denied_explanation: Location access is required to detect your Wi-Fi network for auto-switching. Enable it in Settings.
network.location_off_description: Connected to Wi-Fi, but the network name is hidden. Turn on location services and allow location access to detect it.

quick_connect.selected_user_unavailable: The selected user is no longer available
quick_connect.disabled: Quick Connect is turned off on this server. An administrator can turn it on in the dashboard.

video_player.title: Video player
video_player.native_note: Both options use the MPV engine. Only the player controls differ. The native player uses system controls and opens instantly. Switch back if you run into playback issues.
video_player.exoplayer_note: ExoPlayer doesn't support advanced ASS/SSA subtitle styling or horizontal subtitle alignment. Use MPV if you need them.
video_player.mpv_note: On TV, MPV doesn't currently pass HDR metadata to the display, so HDR10 and HDR10+ content is tone-mapped to SDR. Use ExoPlayer for HDR output.
video_player.native_tv_note: Use the new fully native Apple TV player. Turn this off to return to the previous player if you run into playback issues.
video_player.native_android_tv_note: Use the new fully native Android TV player with the MPV or ExoPlayer engine selected above. Turn this off to return to the previous player if you run into playback issues.

gesture_controls.horizontal_swipe_skip_description: Swipe left or right while controls are hidden to skip.
gesture_controls.left_side_brightness_description: Swipe up or down on the left side to adjust brightness.
gesture_controls.right_side_volume_description: Swipe up or down on the right side to adjust volume.
gesture_controls.hold_to_speed_description: Play at the speed below while you press and hold the video.
gesture_controls.pinch_to_zoom_description: Pinch out to fill the screen, pinch in to fit.
gesture_controls.double_tap_to_seek_description: Double-tap the left or right side of the video to skip back or forward.
gesture_controls.hide_volume_slider_description: Hide the volume slider in the video player.
gesture_controls.hide_brightness_slider_description: Hide the brightness slider in the video player.

subtitles.subtitles_on_mute_hint: Turn subtitles on automatically when muted and off again when sound returns.
subtitles.subtitles_on_mute_allow_restart_hint: Some subtitle formats require the server to reprocess the stream, which briefly interrupts playback. Turn this on to allow it automatically when muted.
subtitles.subtitle_background_hint: Add a semi-transparent black background behind subtitles.

music.title: Music
music.normalization_hint: Play songs at a consistent volume.
music.caching_description: Store upcoming songs in the queue ahead of time. The oldest are removed when the size limit is reached.

plugins.wikidata_awards_hint: Show Oscars and other awards on movie and series pages. This device queries Wikidata directly, not through your Jellyfin server.
plugins.opensubtitles_enabled_hint: Search OpenSubtitles from this device when your Jellyfin server has no subtitle provider. Turning this off keeps searches on your server and leaves any saved API key in place.
plugins.crash_reports_hint: Send anonymous crash and error reports to the Streamyfin developers via Sentry. Reports contain no account data, and server addresses and tokens are removed before sending.

seerr.api_key_from_admin: Your server administrator provides the Seerr credentials, so you can connect as {{username}} without a password.
seerr.auto_login_description: Log in to Seerr when the app opens. With Quick Connect, no password is needed. Otherwise, your Jellyfin password is kept in the device's secure storage and removed when you log out.
